# Nobel Prize laureates: positioning text and parameterizing plots

**Learning objectives:**

-   Build URLs in R in order to extract data from an API;
-   Create a new type of plot with core functions in `ggplot2` by using a little bit of trigonometry; and
-   Parameterize your plotting code to create a function, to make it easier to produce lots of similar graphics with a consistent layout.

## Understanding Process {-}

-   Bringing in the data

-   Exploratory work:

    -   Data exploration

    -   Exploratory sketches

-   Preparing a plot:

    -   Data wrangling

    -   A first plot

    -   Iterative Revisions

        -   Using new packages

        -   Styling using `theme`

## New way of pulling data {-}

```{r}
library(dplyr) ## don't need all of tidyverse
library(readr)
library(glue)

api_url <- "http://api.nobelprize.org/2.1/laureates"
nobel_physics <- read_csv(
  glue(
    "{api_url}?limit=250&nobelPrizeCategory=phy&format=csv"
  )
)

head(nobel_physics)
```

## Data Exploration {-}
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

nobel_physics |> 
    ggplot(aes(y=year-year(birthdate), x=year, color=gender)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(y="Age at award", x="Year of award", title="Nobel Prize laureates in physics")
```

## Wrangling the data {-}
```{r}
nobel_category <- "Physics"

physics_data <- nobel_physics |>
  filter(category == nobel_category) |>
  select(name, gender, year) |>
  arrange(year)
```

## A first plot, using coord_radial {-}
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = physics_data,
    aes(x = year, y = 5, color=gender, label=name),
    angle=90, hjust=0) +
  coord_radial(theta="x",
             rotate_angle=TRUE, 
             expand=FALSE, 
             start=3*pi/4, 
             end=pi/4, 
             reverse="theta") +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Advanced Styling - Fonts and Colors {-}
```{r}
library(sysfonts)
library(showtext)

font_add_google(name = "Passion One")
font_add_google(name = "Ubuntu")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
body_font <- "Ubuntu"
title_font <- "Passion One"

bg_col <- "gray95"
primary_col <- "black"
secondary_col <- "gray75"
```

## Advanced Styling - Plot so far {-}
```{r}
col_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_text(
    data = physics_data,
    aes(x = year, y = 5, color=gender, label=name),
    angle=90, hjust=0, family=body_font, size=1) +
  coord_radial(theta="x",
             rotate_angle=TRUE, 
             expand=FALSE, 
             start=3*pi/4, 
             end=pi/4, 
             reverse="theta") +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(
        "male"=secondary_col, 
        "female"=primary_col))
col_plot
```
## Advanced Styling - Adding a title and caption {-}
```{r}
library(ggtext)
annotated_plot <- col_plot +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 2005,
    y = -2,
    label = "Nobel Prize Laureates",
    family = title_font,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 6,
    hjust=1,
    vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 2005,
    y = -2,
    label = "Physics",
    family = body_font,
    size = 4,
    hjust=1,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-2, 7)) +
## expand margins to make room for title and caption
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0,4,0,0, "cm"))
annotated_plot
```

## Parameterizing the plot {-}
```{r}
category_plot <- function(
    nobel_category,
    nobel_data,
    r = 5,
    bg_col = "gray95",
    primary_col = "black",
    secondary_col = "gray70",
    body_font = "Ubuntu",
    title_font = "Passion One") {
  # Data wrangling
  category_data <- nobel_data |>
    filter(category == nobel_category) |>
    select(name, gender, year) |>
    arrange(year)
  plot_data <- category_data |>
    mutate(
      theta = seq(
        from = pi / 4,
        to = (7 / 4) * pi,
        length.out = nrow(category_data)
      ),
      x = r * cos(theta),
      y = r * sin(theta),
      angle = 180 + 360 * (theta / (2 * pi))
    )
  # Plot
  g <- ggplot() +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data,
      mapping = aes(
        x = x, y = y,
        label = name,
        angle = angle,
        color = gender
      ),
      family = body_font,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "male" = secondary_col,
        "female" = primary_col
      )
    ) +
    annotate("text",
      x = 10, y = 0,
      label = "Nobel Prize Laureates",
      hjust = 1,
      color = primary_col,
      family = title_font,
      size = 7
    ) +
    annotate("text",
      x = 10, y = -1,
      label = nobel_category,
      hjust = 1,
      color = primary_col,
      family = body_font,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-9, 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-7.5, 7.5)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void(base_size = 6, base_family = body_font) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = bg_col, color = bg_col
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = bg_col, color = bg_col
      ),
      plot.caption = element_textbox_simple(
        color = primary_col,
        hjust = 0,
        halign = 0,
        lineheight = 0.5,
        margin = margin(l = 5, b = 5)
      )
    )
  return(g)
}
```

## Testing the function {-}
```{r}
nobel_peace <- read.csv(
  glue(
    "{api_url}?limit=250&nobelPrizeCategory=pea&format=csv"
  )
)

peace_plot <- category_plot(
  "Peace",
  nobel_peace,
  r = 4,
  bg_col = "#FFEDE1",
  primary_col = "#8B1E3F",
  secondary_col = "#7286A0"
)
peace_plot
```
